capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern pyusd-paypal, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

review.evidence: W2R46 reviewed exact VaultV2 source/runtime, constructor-to-block 26115203 event history, native share issuance, roles, current adapters, RegistryList and current subregistries/factories. Block hash 0x1b8e8fe59dc6658999fa93a3f1e1a854885dfb8d7eaacf9a8b1c4a10a1d9bee6; timestamp 2026-10-03T23:48:35Z. All 1377 vault logs were retrieved to terminal pagination. Minted raw shares 81831714506829047382286476 equal deposit shares plus accrued performance/management fee shares transaction-by-transaction, with zero unexplained issuance; burns 13640220502291871378618948 leave 68191494004537176003667528, equal pinned totalSupply. Owner/curator/allocator/sentinel histories and current mappings retain the authored controls; former allocator 0x13de0cee0b83562cbfd46682e10ffa4e3c5090e1 is disabled. Independent pinned Safe storage reads at block 26115203 show RegistryList owner Morpho Safe 0xcba28b38103307ec8da98377fff9816c164f9afa is 6-of-10 with no enabled modules and zero guard, but nonzero fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. Owner and curator Safes are 1-of-1 with no modules and zero guard, but handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. Both verified CompatibilityFallbackHandler sources (https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99 and https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4) expose token callbacks, Safe-bound EIP-1271 approved-message/owner-signature validation, module enumeration, and simulate via simulateAndRevert with reverted side effects. Nonzero fallback reach is not a zero guard and this is not a complete execution-scope certificate. RegistryList owner may append arbitrary registries, and curator may replace or zero adapterRegistry with zero selector delay. Arbitrary future adapters remain reachable through curator authorization and the 259200-second addAdapter delay; no immutable allocation protection or exhaustive factory certificate is asserted. Native minting transfers PYUSD before issuing shares, and fee issuance remains subject to immutable fee/rate bounds. Exact-vault incident search covered issuer risk/security/research notices, Morpho security/audit archives, scoped independent exploit reporting, and issuance/ownership history from creation on 2026-08-14 through the pin. No relevant local mint/control incident found; deprecated Huma V1 Polygon credit-approval exploit, Solana PST risks, Resolv events and parent-issuer history are not this Ethereum wrapper's local mint/control history. Organizational signer identity and independently attested custody remain separate scoped non-disclosures; financial reconciliation and parent supervision are not asserted.
